records.summary: Resurrection mixes Celtic rock, punk-driven guitar riffs and pirate-themed singalongs, with violin adding atmosphere and melodic detail. The review praises the album’s sequencing and instrumental passages, while finding that some recordings capture less vocal force and audience appeal than the band’s live performances.

records.summary: Kiss Me Goodnight pairs raw, intimate alternative rock with fuzz-heavy guitars, reverb and vocals nestled within the mix. The review hears 1990s influences, contrasting chaotic passages and anthemic guitar bursts with the restrained slowcore of “Awake” and the dense closing track.
